name: AWS Security Hub: pull findings
description: Every 5 minutes, reads active Security Hub (CSPM, ASFF) findings with workflow status NEW or NOTIFIED and severity LOW or above that were updated since the previous run, and creates one pending alert per finding (source aws-securityhub, deduplicated on the finding Id).

params.label: AWS region
params.help: Region code, lower case. Use your aggregation (home) region if cross-Region aggregation is on: it returns linked regions' findings too.

secrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Access key id of a dedicated IAM user (read-only policy below).

secrets.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: Secret access key of the same IAM user.

setup:
## AWS side
1. Create an IAM user for this integration with an inline policy allowing `securityhub:GetFindings` (or attach `AWSSecurityHubReadOnlyAccess`).
2. Store its access key as `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, allowed host `securityhub.<region>.amazonaws.com`. If you also install the GuardDuty template with the same key, add both hosts to the two secrets.
3. Install with `AWS_REGION` = the Security Hub administrator / aggregation region.

## How it works
`POST https://securityhub.<region>.amazonaws.com/findings` (GetFindings) with filters `UpdatedAt` Start = previous run, End = this run's fire time; `RecordState` = ACTIVE; `WorkflowStatus` = NEW or NOTIFIED; `SeverityLabel` = CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW (INFORMATIONAL, which includes passed control checks, is skipped); sorted by `UpdatedAt` desc; `MaxResults` 100 (the API maximum).

One alert per finding: external id = finding `Id` (last 255 characters), title = `Title (ProductName, account)`, severity from `Severity.Label` (CRITICAL critical, HIGH high, MEDIUM medium, LOW low, INFORMATIONAL info).

**Updates do not re-alert.** Control findings are re-evaluated periodically and other products update findings in place, which bumps `UpdatedAt`; the external id is the finding Id only, so a re-read finding returns the existing alert. Use `{{ loop.item.Id[-200:] }}:{{ loop.item.UpdatedAt }}` as external id if you want one alert per update.

GuardDuty findings also flow into Security Hub. If you install both templates, add `{"Value": "GuardDuty", "Comparison": "NOT_EQUALS"}` under a `ProductName` filter in the `pull` body to avoid two alerts for one finding.

## Limits
- ponytail: one page per run: at most **100 findings per window** (newest first); `NextToken` is not followed. Narrow the severity filter (e.g. CRITICAL and HIGH only) if a busy account hits it.
- GetFindings is throttled to 3 requests/s (burst 6). A non-200 answer fails the run with `Security Hub GetFindings failed: HTTP <status>` and the next run re-reads the window.

Docs: [GetFindings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/1.0/APIReference/API_GetFindings.html), [DateFilter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/1.0/APIReference/API_DateFilter.html), [Timestamps and throttling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/1.0/APIReference/Welcome.html), [ASFF required attributes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/asff-required-attributes.html).
